column1: # Seconds each test takes in a CI shard, as the CI log reports them ("--- ok: test-x (Ns)").
# One row per test: NAME <tab> macOS <tab> Linux. The macOS shards have 3 CPUs. The Linux column
# is the average of the Linux (bash 5) and the bash 3.2 container shards, which have 4 CPUs.
# A dash means no time is known. A test with no row or a dash counts as 10: a new test needs no
# row. Only the proportions matter: tests/run-tests.sh fills the shards from this table and
# scripts/ci-plan.sh sizes the matrix from it.
# Refresh it from a green full run (a push to next-release or the nightly):
# Rows merge with merge=union (.gitattributes), so two branches that add rows do not conflict.
